why_this_amends_the_draft: The draft named no decision rule, so the campaign was measurement-ready but not decision-ready.
The development pilot showed the explicit-abstention prompt emitting invalid schema on 290 of 328 dev rows, which makes it a weak primary comparator for this output contract.
The primary comparison therefore moves to the matched-supervision control, which is also the article's actual mechanism claim.

amendment_2026_08_18.prospective_test_state_at_amendment: closed; the first test attempt stopped at the checkpoint gate and opened nothing
amendment_2026_08_18.what_changed: retraining under the identical recipe is now permitted, replacing the reuse-only requirement
why: The pilot staged its adapters in server tmpfs and the pilot's cleanup receipt deleted them; no local copy was retained, so the required checkpoints no longer exist.
The instruction that caused this was the pilot brief's unqualified cleanup requirement, which did not exempt the adapters.
The registration's purpose is that checkpoints must not be chosen using test information. Retraining now preserves that purpose, because the test partition is still closed.
conditions: identical base model, seed 20260814, data, hyperparameters and the same three-epoch selection by development loss
training completes before the prospective test is materialized or opened
the retrained checkpoint tree hashes are compared against the pilot's retained hashes and the comparison is reported either way
if the selected epoch differs from the pilot's, that is reported rather than reconciled
the adapters are retained locally this time so the situation cannot recur
unchanged: the primary and gatekept hypotheses and their criteria
the manuscript placement contract for both outcomes

models.reason: epochs were selected by development loss before the test exists, so reusing them keeps the test held out

primary_hypothesis_HN1.criterion: event-cluster bootstrap 95% CI lower bound greater than 0 AND exact McNemar two-sided p below 0.05

gatekept_hypothesis_HN2.claim: polarity discrimination exceeds what question priors alone can reach
gatekept_hypothesis_HN2.metric: paired_sft exact accuracy on the available-No cell
gatekept_hypothesis_HN2.criterion: point estimate above 0.60, the construct's own question-only shortcut ceiling
gatekept_hypothesis_HN2.note: sequential gatekeeping controls the family of two; no further multiplicity adjustment

reported_without_criteria: per-cell exact accuracy and the yes/no/abstain confusion for every arm
constant-yes baseline on the four cells
geometry threshold upper bound on the four cells
low-level nuisance audit and question-only audit on the test partition
explicit_prompt arm including its schema-invalid count

pre_test_gates.on_failure: stop and report; do not proceed to inference

evidence_status_and_scope.label: prospective_structured_evaluation_on_ai_hub
evidence_status_and_scope.geometry_immunity_by_construction: unavailable cells are wrong-region crops fully inside the frame, so in-image fraction cannot separate them
evidence_status_and_scope.constant_answer_immunity_by_construction: available Yes and available No share event, media and question

if_HN1_passes.setup: one new subsection in the experimental setup describing the polarity-balanced prospective evaluation, its construction and its two immunity checks
if_HN1_passes.results: one new table reporting the four cells for the primary arms, the two trivial baselines, and the prompt arm as a diagnostic row
if_HN1_passes.claims: Stage 2 may state that answer-abstention supervision improves polarity-balanced selective response on a surface where neither a constant answer nor crop geometry succeeds
if_HN1_passes.exhibit_budget: pair the new table with one demotion; candidates in priority order are Table 2 notation, then Table 1 related-work compression

if_HN1_fails.results: report the registered null once, in the results section, in its strongest true form
if_HN1_fails.claims: Stage 2 narrows to the surviving comparison, that supervision reduces over-refusal of evidence-bearing inputs relative to prompting, and the polarity claim is withdrawn
if_HN1_fails.no_reframing: the failure is not moved to an appendix, a footnote or a diagnostic label

either_way: the MEVA trivial-baseline results are reported regardless of this outcome
the title is not changed on the basis of this result without a separate decision
